metadata.name: metrex
metadata.description: MetrEx: on-chain underwriting exchange for parametric wildfire risk

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mUSD mint. Stored in Config; every token account is checked against it.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Declared before `vault` because the vault's `init` reads it.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Escrow for this offer. Token authority is the Offer PDA (§5.5).

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: InvalidMarketStatus
errors.msg: Market is not in a status that allows this action

errors.name: InvalidOfferStatus
errors.msg: Offer is not in a status that allows this action

errors.name: InvalidBps
errors.msg: Premium rate must be between 1 and 9,999 bps

errors.name: CoverageTooSmall
errors.msg: Coverage is below the minimum

errors.name: CoverageExceedsTarget
errors.msg: Coverage exceeds the market's coverage target

errors.name: CoverageExceedsRemaining
errors.msg: Accepting this offer would exceed the remaining coverage

errors.name: PremiumRoundsToZero
errors.msg: Premium rounds to zero

errors.name: SelfUnderwriting
errors.msg: The homeowner cannot underwrite their own market

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: Token account has the wrong mint

errors.name: WrongTokenOwner
errors.msg: Token account has the wrong owner

errors.name: OfferMarketMismatch
errors.msg: Offer does not belong to this market

errors.name: NotWinner
errors.msg: Only the winning side can claim

errors.name: InvalidCoordinates
errors.msg: Coordinates or trigger distance out of range

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: VaultBalanceMismatch
errors.msg: Vault balance does not match the expected amount

errors.name: NotHolder
errors.msg: Signer does not hold this side of the position

errors.name: StaleListing
errors.msg: Listing seller no longer holds this side

errors.name: SelfTrade
errors.msg: Buyer cannot be the seller or the opposite-side holder

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price must be at least 1 base unit

errors.name: InsufficientFunds
errors.msg: Insufficient mUSD balance

errors.name: InvalidSide
errors.msg: Side must be 0 (Protection) or 1 (Risk)

errors.name: InvalidScenario
errors.msg: Scenario is not supported by the settlement oracle

fields.name: seller
docs: Must equal the current holder of `side` when listed and when bought.

fields.name: price
docs: mUSD base units the buyer pays the seller.

types.name: Offer
docs: Seeds: `["offer", market, underwriter, offer_nonce: u64 LE]` (§5.4).

fields.name: protection_holder
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until accepted; then the homeowner. Receives the vault on YES.

fields.name: risk_holder
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until accepted; then the underwriter. Receives the vault on NO.

types.name: Property
docs: Admin-registered property. Seeds: `["property", property_id: u16 LE]` (§5.2).
